title: Computer Science (PhD)
institution: McGill University, School of Computer Science
about: McGill's School of Computer Science PhD takes applications for fall admission from September 15. International applicants must apply by December 15 and Canadian applicants by February 15. Applicants name at least three proposed supervisors.
requirements: M.Sc. degree in Computer Science or a closely related area, minimum CGPA 3.2 out of 4.0
List at least 3 proposed supervisors in the application
International applicants: December 15 deadline; Canadian citizens and permanent residents: February 15
Applications completed by December 15 are automatically considered for funding

why: "Computer science research" (skill) -> "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
